entry.title: New: dsh-plugin-video-player
entry.summary: TikTok-style video feed in a floating sidebar window: swipe local or SMB-NAS folders, or paste online video URLs (yt-dlp, bilibili/YouTube, cookies.txt login state); the window auto-fits the video aspect ratio, with fullscreen, drag-resize, Range streaming and an agent video-queue endpoint. Exact install spec: github:anitman/dsh-plugin-video-player. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
